title: Community Nutrition Programs: From Needs Assessment to Evaluation
subject: Community Nutrition and Public Health
description: Design a community nutrition program from a shared needs assessment through a logic model, measurable outcomes, credible evaluation, and an evidence-based decision.
outcomes: Translate community evidence into a bounded nutrition priority
Build a logic model with measurable short-, medium-, and long-term outcomes
Design an evaluation whose findings can support a real program decision

catalogAlignment.relationship: Independent reusable companion; not an official RIT course section
